series.name: ZYN British Superbike Championship (BSB)
series.notes: Premier UK road race series, 38th season in 2025. Kyle Ryde champion 2024 & 2025. 10 rounds at Brands Hatch, Donington, Thruxton, Knockhill, Cadwell, Snetterton, Oulton Park and Silverstone GP. From 2026 sponsored by ZYN. Pirelli control tyre (confirmed). Promoted by MSVR; governed by MCRCB under ACU delegation.

series.name: British Supersport Championship
series.notes: BSB support series; 600cc production-based. Adopted Supersport Next Generation regulations for 2025 onwards.

series.name: Supersport Next Generation
series.notes: Next-gen Supersport technical format integrated into British Supersport from 2025.

series.name: National Superstock 1000
series.notes: BSB support class; stock-based 1000cc machines. Traditional stepping stone to BSB.

series.name: British Talent Cup
series.notes: Junior development series supporting BSB; pathway from club racing / Superteen to national level.

series.name: BMW Motorrad Cup
series.notes: BSB support class; one-make BMW S1000RR series.

series.name: National Sportbike Championship
series.notes: BSB support class; production sportbike entry-level national.

series.name: Kawasaki British Superteen Championship
series.notes: BSB support junior series for young riders on Kawasaki Ninja 400.

series.name: BMCRC (Bemsee) Club Championship
series.notes: Multi-class club championship at Brands Indy, Cadwell, Snetterton, Silverstone National, Oulton, Mallory. Classes: Formula 400, Clubman Superstock, Thunderbike, Open 500, Sidecar and junior classes.

series.name: Thundersport GB Club Championship
series.notes: Large national club series primarily at Mallory Park; Superstock 600/1000, Supertwins, Thunderbike, endurance.

series.name: Classic Racing Motorcycle Club (CRMC) Championship
series.notes: Pre-1978 classics at major UK circuits. Annual Cadwell Park Gold Cup a highlight.

series.name: Isle of Man TT
series.notes: World's most famous road race; Mountain Course 60.72 km; annual late May/early June. Classes: Superbike, Supersport, Superstock, Senior TT, TT Zero (EV), Sidecars. Separate ACU / IOM licence required.

series.name: Manx Grand Prix
series.notes: Amateur road race on the TT Mountain Course; annual August/September. Entry-level TT-style event for riders without TT experience.

series.name: North West 200
series.notes: Ireland's largest outdoor sporting event; public-road course near Portstewart/Portrush/Coleraine; annual May. 150,000+ spectators. Classes: Superbike, Supersport, Superstock, Supertwin.

series.name: Ulster Grand Prix (historic / revival status)
series.notes: Dundrod circuit (7.4 mi); currently defunct as a regular event. Historically 'world's fastest road race'. Revival discussions ongoing — verify current status.

series.name: Oliver's Mount Road Races (Scarborough)
series.notes: England's only purpose-built road race circuit; hillside course at Scarborough, North Yorkshire. Spring and Gold Cup autumn meetings. Classes mirror ACU club road race grades. 2.41 mi (3.88 km) course.

series.name: NG Road Racing Club Championship
series.notes: 2025: launched two new budget-friendly Naked championships alongside existing Superstock classes.

series.name: EMRA Championship
series.notes: ACU-affiliated club championship primarily at Snetterton; production and Superstock classes.

series.name: Scottish Motorcycle Racing Championships
series.notes: SACU-organised national championship held at Knockhill Racing Circuit.
